messages.subject: Additional Polygons to detectionMaps
parts:
Hello. Thank you for creating this awesome package!

I have a question regarding the function detectionMaps. I currently have the function working with a backgroundPolygon (initially with the error "S4' to vector of type 'double," but fixed by loading the functions you attached here: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/camtrapr/v_6V4HKl_3A/-tK3EP4qCQAJ). 

I'm now trying to add some additional lines/polygons to the plot (e.g. some trails, rivers), but with a simple: plot(River, add=TRUE) they don't line up with the detectionMaps plot. Figures attached. 

Any help you can provide would be much appreciated! Hoping this is a relatively simple fix. 

Thanks!
Michael

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Additional Polygons to detectionMaps
parts:
Hi Michael,
yes, the function wasn't designed to provide proper plotting like you're planning to do, I didn't test it or write it that way. Those are basically just quick and dirty plots to understand the data.

My suggestion would be to use the shapefile output of the detectionHistory function and then create a proper map with it, either in GIS or R. That way you won't have those issues with misaligned features. The maps may look different, but most likely better and you'll have more freedom creating the look you want.

On a side note, you still get errors with the current version of the package? If so, please let me know and I'll check. 

All the best,
Jürgen
